name: The Twin Fangs
source: BigWigs (BigWigsMods/BigWigs) TheVenomousAbyss/TwinFangs.lua + Icy Veins boss guide (mechanics). Timings checked 24 Oct 2026 against Lorrgs.io (boss cast timelines of the top 50 Outlaw Rogue kills per difficulty, api2.lorrgs.io): see `checked` per difficulty.
notes: Edit freely (Fight settings > Edit…). Times are seconds after the start of the mechanic's stage. Stage starts come from the guide/BigWigs where noted, otherwise from a percentage of the fight length. timesFrom: bigwigs = timeline durations read from BigWigs (only ~the first minute or two of each stage is visible there), guide = from the Icy Veins guide, assumed = my guess. 'assumed' lists effect sizes that are guesses. Not modelled: tank/healer mechanics, raid damage, Bloodlust timing.

heroic.label: Normal / Heroic
heroic.checked: Lorrgs 50 kills, median 291 s (casts from 2 logs): Caustic Deluge 10/78/179/247, Venomous Emergence 40/107/209/277, Stir the Depths 52/120/222, Ravenous Feast 68/135/237, Sanguine Storm + Vile Flood (submerge) 150/154, next deluge 179 -> ~29 s submerge, 169 s cycle.

mythic.label: Mythic
mythic.checked: Lorrgs 50 kills, median 400 s: Caustic Deluge 9/70/164/225/319/380, Venomous Emergence 36/97/191/252/346, Stir the Depths 47/108/202/263/357, Ravenous Feast 61/122/216/277/371, submerge (Sanguine Storm / Vile Flood) 136/291, next deluge 164 -> ~28 s submerge, 155 s cycle.

council: Two bosses with separate health (Icy Veins: they do not share health and should die together), tanked close and cleaved (Method: start on Vexhul while cleaving Ithraz, swap at 40 %). Simulated as 2 targets for the whole fight; both submerge together.
